items.summary: Recommendation: approve only three normal-priority, metadata-only task-routing repairs for 0daynews.com, amputeenews.com, and eastcoastrappers.com. Reject the weirdassstuff.com monetization review because existing read-only telemetry already supplies the stated affiliate attribution fields and the review does not create a production or financial decision. Preserve one bounded public inspection for weapontester.com to close the observable positioning and conversion-path evidence gap. Reject unsupported revenue or causal claims, duplicate telemetry, production changes, credential/configuration changes, spending, schedule changes, and high-priority queue work.
